title_zh: 请求私下了解职场投诉流程

scenario.label_zh: 约定私下了解职场投诉流程并先核对笔记
scenario.goal_zh: 说明不愿在公开会议中处理辱骂问题，请代表在私下会面时解释流程并先核对记录

context_zh: 虚构工作场所支持咨询，不涉及真实个人指控。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: The verbal abuse in yesterday's meeting was unacceptable. I want to report it, but not in another meeting with everyone there.

sentences.speaker: Union representative
sentences.text: We can talk privately first. You don't have to give me the full account in this reception area.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: My colleague keeps saying I should send a message to the whole office.

sentences.speaker: Union representative
sentences.text: I would urge you to decide what you're comfortable sharing after we discuss the reporting process.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Could we meet in the side room now? I'd like you to explain the process and read the notes I've brought before anything is sent.

sentences.speaker: Union representative
sentences.text: Yes. We'll talk there, and I won't pass on your notes without checking with you.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Thank you. That's the first step I want.
